till-he-come: Spurgeon's communion meditations on the nearness of Christ and the sweetness of His love, for believers at the Lord's Table.
treatises-of-cyprian: The bishop-martyr of Carthage on the Lord's Prayer, facing death, generosity, unity, patience and envy, written amid plague.
true-vine: Thirty-one daily meditations on John 15, in which Murray presses the one secret of a fruitful life: abiding in Christ.
tukutendereza: Twelve lives from the East African Revival, the Balokole, each told with what it teaches and ending in prayer.
union-and-communion: Taylor reads the Song of Solomon as the soul's journey from first communion with Christ into unbroken union with Him.
unspoken-sermons: MacDonald's 36 sermons on the words of Jesus and a Father whose love will not rest until his children are like his Son.
waiting-on-god: Thirty-one daily readings by Murray on waiting on God patiently, quietly and continually, each one turned into prayer.
watchman-nee-a-life: A biography of Watchman Nee placing his teaching within his life, from conversion to twenty years in a Communist prison.
watchman-nee-a-life-teens: Watchman Nee's life retold for teens: a young Chinese preacher, the church he built, and twenty years in prison.
way-into-holiest: Meyer's exposition of Hebrews, on Christ's priesthood, the peril of drifting and the way into the holiest by his blood.
women-who-moved-heaven-2: Women who changed history through persistent prayer, from Monica's seventeen-year intercession to Corrie ten Boom.
